purpose: The hashed suppression route ships, on the Chair's approval of 23 November 2026: send.html checks each address and its domain against suppression-hashed.json (SHA-256 only, no readable address) and holds only a match; the plain suppression.json stays empty under Item 381-G, and an unreadable or malformed list still holds every address. First entries: the four contacts Apollo marks unsubscribed.
